description: The ``AWS::ECR::PullThroughCacheRule`` resource creates or updates a pull through cache rule. A pull through cache rule provides a way to cache images from an upstream registry in your Amazon ECR private registry.. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-resource-providers-ecr.git

RegistryId.description: The account ID of the registry pull-through cache repository will be created in.
RegistryId.title: AWSECRPullThroughCacheRuleRegistryIdDefinition

EcrRepositoryPrefix.description: The ECRRepositoryPrefix is a custom alias for upstream registry url.
EcrRepositoryPrefix.title: AWSECRPullThroughCacheRuleEcrRepositoryPrefixDefinition

UpstreamRegistryUrl.description: The upstreamRegistryUrl is the endpoint of upstream registry url of the public repository to be cached
UpstreamRegistryUrl.title: AWSECRPullThroughCacheRuleUpstreamRegistryUrlDefinition

CredentialArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that identifies the credentials to authenticate to the upstream registry.
CredentialArn.title: AWSECRPullThroughCacheRuleCredentialArnDefinition

UpstreamRegistry.description: The name of the upstream registry.
UpstreamRegistry.title: AWSECRPullThroughCacheRuleUpstreamRegistryDefinition

CustomRoleArn.description: The ARN of the IAM role to be assumed by Amazon ECR to authenticate to ECR upstream registry. This role must be in the same account as the registry that you are configuring.
CustomRoleArn.title: AWSECRPullThroughCacheRuleCustomRoleArnDefinition

UpstreamRepositoryPrefix.description: The repository name prefix of upstream registry to match with the upstream repository name. When this field isn't specified, Amazon ECR will use the `ROOT`.
UpstreamRepositoryPrefix.title: AWSECRPullThroughCacheRuleUpstreamRepositoryPrefixDefinition

EcrRepositoryPrefix.description: The Amazon ECR repository prefix associated with the pull through cache rule.

UpstreamRegistryUrl.description: The upstream registry URL associated with the pull through cache rule.

CredentialArn.description: The ARN of the Secrets Manager secret associated with the pull through cache rule.

UpstreamRegistry.description: The name of the upstream source registry associated with the pull through cache rule.

CustomRoleArn.description: The ARN of the IAM role associated with the pull through cache rule.

UpstreamRepositoryPrefix.description: The upstream repository prefix associated with the pull through cache rule.
